messages:
Anya: Heads-up: Aegis Health signed an enterprise commit. POC next Mon. They expect steady ~40 rps, bursts to ~350 rps for 20-40s. Need reserved vs burst sizing and autoscale plan.
Devon: What model and token profile? Also target p95 latency?
Anya: Model: open-70B-quant, avg prompt 45 tokens, gen 120 tokens, rare long jobs ~800 tokens. p95 <400ms. Private/VPC required.
Martin: Quick estimate: steady 40 rps ~= 2 GPUs with KV warm cache; bursts to 350 rps need ~6 prewarmed GPUs or autoscale to 8 with warmup. Options: reserved 6 GPUs or reserved 3 + burst credits.
Lina: On A100-like hw open-70B-quant ~50-70 rps/GPU depending on sequence length; KV warmups give ~1.5x effective throughput. Recommend fallback policy to open-13B-quant for graceful degradation.
Anya: Can Private support reserved + burst?
Martin: Yes. Private supports reserved pools and controlled burst credits. Ops: KMS access required for model artifacts, KMS onboarding ~48h. Also map AZ affinity to customer's VPC.
Devon: Draft autoscale: min 2, max 8, target ~60 qps/replica, cool-down 60s, prewarm enabled before windows.
Lina: Add KV warmup step: run ~1k representative sample requests during preheat. Also create routing rule: 70B primary, 13B fallback.
Martin: Cost note: reserved 6 GPUs gives best latency for spikes ~<=280 rps without queueing; for 350 rps need burst credits or temporary overprovision. I'll produce a cost vs SLA matrix.
Anya: Action items: Martin -> cost/runway + fallback list by EOD. Devon -> preheat job script + staging smoke test. Lina -> KV warmup recipe + routing config. I'll coordinate customer preheat window.
SRE-Bot: staging preheat job created by Devon 2026-03-18T08:50Z, test scheduled 2026-03-18T09:10Z.
Anya: Sync tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll share deliverables in deal channel after EOD.
